title: Frontdesk Turn v0.1 — the closed output contract of the conversational front desk
description: One turn of the conversation.frontdesk role. This is the FORCED output shape of the front desk's model call: the LLM does not emit free text with side effects, it emits exactly one of seven typed turns, and the runtime acts only on what the closed payload carries. A turn that fails this schema is downgraded to CHAT_REPLY by the runtime (uncertain => submits nothing). The privilege separation lives here: five of the seven kinds are read-only, and the two that change anything (SUBMIT_TASK, CANCEL_TASK) can only feed the already-governed task queue — there is no payload field through which a turn could name a tool, a file, a provider, or a permission.

turn_kind.description: What this turn asks the runtime to do. SUBMIT_TASK/CANCEL_TASK feed the task queue; QUERY_* are read-only lookups the runtime answers from the task registry/ledger; CLARIFY asks the operator a question instead of guessing; CHAT_REPLY is conversation with no runtime action at all — and is also the mandatory downgrade for any turn the runtime cannot validate.

payload.description: The kind-specific closed arguments. Every variant is additionalProperties:false — an unexpected field is a schema failure, never a silently ignored extra.

reply_text.description: What the operator sees for this turn, in natural language. Always required: even a SUBMIT_TASK narrates what was submitted, so the operator can catch a misunderstanding before the pipeline finishes. For SUBMIT_TASK this narration is confirmation only — the pipeline receives payload.request_text verbatim, never this rendering.

request_text.description: The operator's request VERBATIM — the exact words to submit to the pipeline. The front desk must not paraphrase, summarize, or translate here; its own understanding belongs in reply_text, where the operator can check it. Verbatimness itself is enforced by the runtime against the conversation, not by this schema.

important.description: True only when the operator marked the request important (!중요 semantics), never inferred from tone.

independent_validation.description: True only when the operator asked for independent review, never volunteered.

limit.description: How many finished entries to list. Null means the runtime default; the runtime clamps, this schema only types.

entry_id.description: The task-registry entry id (or unambiguous prefix) whose deliverable to re-send.
The QUEUED task-registry entry to cancel. The runtime's own rules still apply (QUEUED only — stopping running work stays the kill switch's authority).
